descriptions.normal: A fish served in sauce. Fresh fish filets were dried before pan-fried until crispy, then drizzled with a creamy white dressing and sprinkled with fresh mint. A unique dish that can be made through the simplest methods.
descriptions.suspicious: A fish dish served in sauce. The outside was burnt in searing hot oil. It is rather hard not to notice the sharp contrast between the charcoal-black fish and the milk-white sauce. Only the meat inside seems edible... Wait, what's with this sourness?
descriptions.delicious: A fish dish served with sauce. The translucent fillet lies upon exquisite cream sauce, offering a burst of freshness reminiscent of fish leaping from water with just one bite.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 20% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 390 HP every 5s for 30s.
